entries.title: 儀表板總覽
entries.summary: 依期間查看營運、獲授權的財務與損益指標及待辦，追蹤資料狀態並連到來源功能。

steps: 開啟營運總覽，先確認所選公司與資料日期。
由待辦或指標進入原功能核對，留意載入中、部分資料與資料可能過期等提示。
boundaries: 儀表板數字與 AI 摘要不能替代原單據；載入失敗或沒有資料不表示金額為零。
儲運專用角色會進入儲運工作區；工作台啟用時，只有維修與個人權限的維修師進入 DOA 售後維修工作區，營運總覽入口會隱藏。兼任其他作業的人員仍依合併權限使用營運總覽。
成本、毛利、淨利，以及可反推出費用的廣告費、平台費、淨入帳等指標，依專用讀取權限顯示；無權限時不可把缺少的指標解讀為零。完整高階財務總覽需成本、毛利及淨利三項讀取授權。
收發室／維修權限已開通且工作台啟用時，一般同仁登入會進入對應工作台；右上角「我的待辦」保留未完成交接。

en.title: Dashboard overview
en.summary: Review operations, authorized financial and profit metrics, and work queues by period, checking data status and source features.

steps: Open the dashboard and check the selected company and data date.
Follow a work item or metric to its source feature and check loading, partial-data and stale-data indicators.
boundaries: Metrics and AI summaries do not replace source documents; failed or missing data is not a zero balance.

Warehouse-only users enter their warehouse workspace. With the workbench enabled, technicians holding only repair and personal permissions enter the DOA after-sales repair workspace, with the dashboard destination hidden. Mixed-duty staff keep dashboard access according to their combined grants.

Cost, margin and net-profit figures, and advertising spend, platform fees or net payout that could reveal expenses, depend on separate read grants; a missing metric is not zero. The full executive financial overview requires all three grants.
When enabled, mailroom and repair staff land on their workbench. My inbox keeps handoffs pending until the assigned work is completed.

entries.title: 費用申請
entries.summary: 建立費用時先選員工代墊或廠商直付、上傳憑證並確認辨識草稿，再選報銷項目、金額、幣別、日期與說明後送出。AI 辨識或分類只是建議，需核對憑證，不會自動付款。

steps: 選擇員工代墊或廠商直付，填寫受款與費用資料。
上傳圖片或 PDF 憑證，辨識完成後逐欄核對；AI 建議可修改。
選擇可用報銷項目，確認金額、幣別、日期及直屬主管設定後送出，於清單追蹤狀態。
全部必要審批核准後，ERP 才建立待付款任務，供出納後續處理。
實際銀行匯款由出納依公司外部銀行流程完成；費用核准或待付款任務不會自動向銀行匯款。
外部銀行付款完成後，出納再於 ERP 登記已完成的付款，填入實際銀行、日期及完整金額；此登記更新費用與待付款任務狀態。
會計入帳另走獨立流程，由具有分錄建立及核准權限的人員建立、審核分錄並完成過帳；不會因費用核准或付款登記而自動完成。
boundaries: 必須有新增費用權限、有效員工與可審批的同公司主管；不可自己審核自己的申請。
AI 辨識與科目推薦不是憑證真偽確認、核准、付款或入帳。限制角色或部門的項目不能越權使用。
費用核准、待付款任務、外部銀行匯款、ERP 付款登記與會計過帳各有獨立狀態與憑據，不能由其中一項推定其他項目已完成；銀行匯款與會計過帳也不是二選一的替代動作。

en.title: Expense requests
en.summary: Choose employee reimbursement or direct vendor payment, upload evidence, review AI suggestions, and submit the item, amount, currency, date and description. AI does not make payments.

steps: Select employee reimbursement or direct vendor payment and fill in the payee and expense details.
Upload image or PDF evidence and check every suggested field; AI suggestions remain editable.
Select an eligible reimbursement item, verify amount, currency, date and supervisor setup, then submit and track status.
ERP creates a pending payment task only after every required approval is complete, for the cashier to handle.
The cashier completes the actual bank transfer through the company’s external banking process. Expense approval and a pending payment task do not initiate a bank transfer.
After external bank payment is complete, the cashier records that completed payment in ERP with the actual bank account, date and full amount. This updates the expense and payment-task status.

Accounting posting follows a separate workflow: staff with journal-create and journal-approve permissions create and review the journal for posting. Expense approval or payment recording does not complete this automatically.
boundaries: Creation requires the expense-create permission, an active employee relationship and an eligible supervisor in the same company. Self-approval is prohibited.
Extraction and account suggestions do not validate authenticity, approve, pay or post the expense. Restricted items require eligibility.

Expense approval, the pending payment task, external bank transfer, ERP payment recording and accounting posting each have separate statuses and evidence. None proves the others are complete; a bank transfer and accounting posting are not interchangeable alternatives.

entries.title: 費用審核中心
entries.summary: 主管在費用審核中心查看指派給自己的申請與憑證、核准或退回。直屬主管來自員工資料的主管設定，未設定或無有效審批人員時須先由管理員補齊；主管核准後，若該報銷項目有額外審批政策，仍須完成後續審批；全部核准後才進入出納待付款。

steps: 在費用審核中心開啟指派給自己的待審申請，閱讀金額、說明與原始憑證。
核對後核准或退回並填寫需要的意見；一般主管不需替會計決定正式入帳科目。
歷史待審單若尚無審批步驟，由授權管理員預覽目前主管並確認建立審批；既有已指派案件不可任意重派。
全部必要審批核准後，ERP 才建立待付款任務，供出納後續處理。
實際銀行匯款由出納依公司外部銀行流程完成；費用核准或待付款任務不會自動向銀行匯款。
外部銀行付款完成後，出納再於 ERP 登記已完成的付款，填入實際銀行、日期及完整金額；此登記更新費用與待付款任務狀態。
會計入帳另走獨立流程，由具有分錄建立及核准權限的人員建立、審核分錄並完成過帳；不會因費用核准或付款登記而自動完成。
boundaries: 只有目前有效指派的審批人可處理該步驟；送出時的主管快照不隨人事異動自動改派。
全部必要步驟核准後才建立待付款任務。核准本身不觸發銀行匯款或會計過帳。
費用核准、待付款任務、外部銀行匯款、ERP 付款登記與會計過帳各有獨立狀態與憑據，不能由其中一項推定其他項目已完成；銀行匯款與會計過帳也不是二選一的替代動作。

en.title: Expense review
en.summary: Review assigned evidence and approve or reject. Supervisor assignment is based on employee setup; additional item policies may require further approvals before payment is queued.

steps: Open an assigned pending request and inspect the amount, description and original evidence.
Approve or reject after review and record the required comments; a supervisor need not determine the final posting account.
For a legacy pending request without steps, an authorized administrator previews and confirms assignment to the current eligible supervisor. Existing assignments are not freely reassigned.
ERP creates a pending payment task only after every required approval is complete, for the cashier to handle.
The cashier completes the actual bank transfer through the company’s external banking process. Expense approval and a pending payment task do not initiate a bank transfer.
After external bank payment is complete, the cashier records that completed payment in ERP with the actual bank account, date and full amount. This updates the expense and payment-task status.

Accounting posting follows a separate workflow: staff with journal-create and journal-approve permissions create and review the journal for posting. Expense approval or payment recording does not complete this automatically.
boundaries: Only the currently assigned approver can act on a step. The submitted supervisor snapshot does not change automatically with HR edits.
A payment task is created only after all required steps pass; approval neither transfers money nor posts a journal.

Expense approval, the pending payment task, external bank transfer, ERP payment recording and accounting posting each have separate statuses and evidence. None proves the others are complete; a bank transfer and accounting posting are not interchangeable alternatives.

entries.title: 應付與待付款中心
entries.summary: 已完成必要審核的費用進入出納待付款任務。出納應核對受款人、幣別、應付金額與付款方式，實際付款後再登錄付款資訊。申請、憑證、審核、付款與正式會計入帳是不同狀態，核准不表示已付款或已入帳。

steps: 在費用付款頁查看待付費用與應付單據，核對到期日、受款人及金額。
費用實際付款後，選擇有權限的同公司、同幣別出帳銀行與付款日期，再登錄付款。
返回單據檢查付款狀態；費用只允許一次完整付款登記。
boundaries: 出納登記需銀行修改權限及帳戶可見權；頁面入口不等於銀行操作授權。
費用登記不呼叫真實銀行付款。應付發票與費用是不同來源，不可重複支付同一義務。

en.title: Payables and payment queue
en.summary: Completed approvals produce cashier tasks. Check payee, currency, amount and payment method, then record an actual payment. Approval, payment and accounting posting are separate states.

steps: Review pending expenses and payable documents, including due date, payee and amount.
After an expense is actually paid, select an accessible bank account in the same company and currency and record the payment date.
Verify the resulting status; an expense permits one full payment record.
boundaries: Recording payment requires banking-update access and account visibility, beyond page access.
Expense recording does not invoke a bank transfer. Payable invoices and expense requests have distinct sources; do not pay the same obligation twice.

entries.title: 報銷項目管理
entries.summary: 管理報銷項目、關鍵字、對應科目、憑證與使用限制，並可建立預設庫。

steps: 選定公司後新增或編輯報銷項目，填入名稱、描述、關鍵字及對應科目。
依制度設定金額上限、憑證類型、允許角色與部門、額外審批政策，再儲存。
不再使用時停用項目；使用「建立預設庫」前先確認目前公司與既有項目。
boundaries: 項目限制同時影響員工選項與送出資格；設定項目不等於替員工指派角色或主管。
AI 分類只提供建議，正式會計科目與入帳仍需依流程確認。

en.title: Reimbursement items
en.summary: Manage reimbursement items, keywords, mapped accounts, receipts and eligibility, and load starter items.

steps: Select the company and create or edit an item with name, description, keywords and mapped account.
Set amount limits, receipt types, eligible roles and departments, and additional approval policy, then save.
Disable retired items. Before using Load starter items, check the company and existing records.
boundaries: Eligibility applies to both displayed choices and submission. Item configuration does not assign employee roles or supervisors.
AI classification is advisory; the final account and posting still require their workflow.

entries.title: 系統設定
entries.summary: 個人介面設定可由右上角帳號選單開啟；系統設定由管理員維護。Copilot 支援標準與深度模式，AI 連線由部署環境的管理員設定，畫面不會提供或顯示金鑰。

steps: 開啟系統設定，先成功載入目前的薪資規則。
核對月薪工時、加班倍率與相關保險自付比例後，使用「儲存薪資規則」。
AI 連線由部署管理員設定，使用者只選擇畫面提供的標準或深度模式。
boundaries: 通知、安全與一般設定頁籤目前為預覽，不會儲存到後端。
薪資規則載入失敗時不可覆寫；不要在對話中提供 AI 金鑰或密碼。

en.title: System settings
en.summary: Personal presentation settings are available from the account menu; administrators manage system settings. AI modes use deployment configuration and never expose provider keys.

steps: Open system settings and first load the existing payroll rules successfully.
Check monthly hours, overtime multipliers and insurance contribution rates, then save payroll rules.
Provider connection is configured by deployment administrators; users choose the available standard or deep mode.
boundaries: Notification, security and general-setting tabs are previews and do not persist to the backend.
Do not overwrite payroll rules after a failed load, or share provider keys or passwords in chat.

entries.title: 權限管理
entries.summary: 在「使用者」先篩選帳號、指派職務範本並查看有效權限；多角色權限合併。帳號維護與角色政策分開：一般帳號管理者只能指派已核准的作業角色，最高管理員才可修改共用角色、公司及資料範圍。成本、毛利、淨利與同仁薪資須個別授權。

steps: 在「使用者」依姓名或 Email、帳號狀態與職務範本篩選，選定帳號後查看目前角色、敏感資料標示及有效權限。
建立或編輯帳號時先選最符合工作內容的職務範本；兼任時才增加角色。一般管理者新增帳號會自動歸入其唯一所屬公司；需要存取本人資料的職務，接著在員工管理連結員工資料並核對有效權限。
只有最高管理員可在「角色」建立或修改共用角色及其權限，並設定帳號可存取公司與各模組資料範圍。
部門與主管身分在員工管理維護；考績評核另需專用權限及逐筆指派，不能只憑主管職稱取得。
收發室使用「收發室人員」範本，維修部使用「維修師」範本 REPAIR_TECHNICIAN，包含 repair_workbench:read／update；確認同公司的有效員工綁定。客服覆核 mailroom:review 由最高管理員明確指派，維修師及部門預設角色不授予此覆核權限或會計入帳確認權限。
boundaries: 具有帳號更新權限的一般管理者只能維護一般帳號並指派明確開放的作業角色；管理員、敏感或未知權限角色，以及共用角色政策，均由最高管理員處理。
一般帳號管理者僅能查看及維護其可管理公司內的帳號；目標若無公司或同時屬於其他公司，交由最高管理員處理。一般管理者若屬於零個或多個公司，需請最高管理員明確選擇新帳號公司。
新帳號的資料範圍預設為「自己」；若未連結同公司的有效員工資料，多數公司資料操作仍會受後端範圍限制，不應自動放大成全公司。
成本需 product_cost:read；毛利另需 financial_margin:read，淨利再需 financial_net_profit:read；同仁薪資另需 employee_compensation:read。資料範圍或看得到選單不代表可讀敏感欄位、修改、審批或跨公司存取。
多角色權限取聯集。畫面預覽供核對，實際操作仍受後端權限、公司、資料範圍和逐筆指派限制；Copilot 不可繞過。

en.title: Access control
en.summary: Start with Users: filter accounts, assign job templates and inspect effective access. Multiple roles combine. Account maintenance and role policy are separate: account managers may assign approved operational roles, while only super administrators change shared roles, company access and data scopes. Cost, margin, net profit and coworker pay require separate grants.

steps: In Users, filter by name or email, account status and job template. Open an account to inspect roles, sensitive-data labels and effective access.

When creating or editing an account, choose the closest job template first and add another role only for a second duty. An ordinary account manager’s new account is assigned to their sole company. For self-scoped work, link the employee record in employee management and then check effective access.
Only a super administrator creates or changes shared roles and their permissions, and sets an account’s company access and module data scopes.
Maintain department and supervisor identity in employee records. Performance review also requires explicit permission and assignment; a supervisor title alone is insufficient.

Assign MAILROOM_OPERATOR or the Repair technician template REPAIR_TECHNICIAN to linked active employees in the same company. The technician has repair_workbench:read/update. A policy administrator explicitly grants mailroom:review to customer-service reviewers; technician and department defaults do not grant review or accounting payment-confirmation permission.
boundaries: An account manager with update access can maintain ordinary accounts and assign only explicitly approved operational roles. Administrator, sensitive or unknown-permission roles and shared role policy require a super administrator.

An ordinary account manager can view and maintain only accounts wholly within their manageable companies. Accounts with no company or an additional outside company require a super administrator. When the manager has zero or multiple companies, a super administrator must choose the new account’s company explicitly.

A new account’s data scopes default to Self. Without a linked active employee in the same company, many company-data operations remain blocked by server scope checks; do not automatically widen them to the whole company.

Cost requires product_cost:read; margin additionally requires financial_margin:read, and net profit additionally requires financial_net_profit:read. Coworker pay separately requires employee_compensation:read. Data scope or a visible menu grants none of these fields, writes, approval or cross-company access.
Role permissions combine. The preview is for checking; server permissions, company and data scopes, and record assignment still control operations. Copilot cannot bypass them.

entries.title: 銷售訂單
entries.summary: 查看訂單狀態、客戶、渠道與銷售金額，並辨識 B2B 確認接單後建立的銷單。

steps: 確認公司，依訂單日期、渠道或狀態查詢訂單。
開啟訂單查看品項、金額及來源，追蹤付款、發票與出貨的各別狀態。
B2B 採購需求須由員工先逐行人工核庫、出具正式報價，並由客戶登入接受最新版本；業務再於客戶採購工作台確認接單，建立的銷單可在此查閱。出貨與正式扣庫另至儲運及交運待核銷核對。
boundaries: 來源平台同步與手動建立的訂單須保留來源識別；訂單金額不是銀行實收。
B2B 確認接單會預留庫存，從接單起就不能用舊整單出庫入口扣庫；WMS 裝箱或交運事件不等於 ERP 正式扣庫，須在交運待核銷逐行核准。
Copilot 查單僅限已註冊且通過授權的讀取工具，不能據此聲稱已出貨。

en.title: Sales orders
en.summary: View order status, customers, channels and sales amounts, including sales orders created from confirmed B2B requests.

steps: Confirm the company and filter orders by date, channel or status.
Open an order to inspect lines, amounts and source, tracking payment, invoicing and fulfilment separately.

For B2B requests, staff manually review every line, issue a formal quotation, and wait for the customer to sign in and accept its latest version. Sales then confirm the order in the customer procurement workbench. Find the resulting sales order here; review fulfilment and final deduction separately in warehouse and handover reconciliation.
boundaries: Preserve platform or manual source identifiers; order value is not bank cash received.

Confirming a B2B order reserves stock and blocks the legacy whole-order fulfilment action immediately. WMS packing or a handover event does not post the final ERP inventory deduction; approve each line in handover reconciliation.
Copilot order lookup uses registered authorized read tools and is not proof of shipment.

entries.title: 客戶管理
entries.summary: 依授權公司建立與維護客戶基本資料、聯絡方式與客戶類型。

steps: 先選擇公司，在客戶管理以伺服器搜尋及分頁查找客戶，比對姓名、公司與聯絡資訊避免重複。
依畫面及業務權限建立或維護該公司客戶資料，再於訂單或報價選用。
boundaries: 客戶列表的來源欄只取最近一張銷售訂單；總訂單數涵蓋該公司的全部訂單，來源欄不能當作所有訂單來源。
聯絡資訊是公司業務資料，只能在授權公司及業務範圍內使用。
停用客戶會保留既有銷單與採購需求歷史，並阻止其客戶入口帳號後續使用；建立或查看客戶不等於已寄送報價或訊息。

en.title: Customers
en.summary: Create and maintain customer profiles, contact details and customer types within an authorized company.

steps: Select the company, then use server-side search and pagination to find a customer and compare name, company and contact details to avoid duplicates.
Create or maintain that company's customer where your sales permissions allow, then select the record for an order or quotation.
boundaries: The source shown in the customer list comes from the latest sales order only; the total order count covers all orders in that company and the source does not describe every order.
Contact information is business data limited to authorized companies and purposes.
Deactivating a customer preserves sales and request history and blocks further customer-portal access. Creating or viewing a customer does not send a quotation or message.

entries.title: 商品管理
entries.summary: 查看商品 SKU、名稱、售價與庫存快照；成本欄位僅對另有成本讀取權限者顯示。

steps: 在產品與庫存頁確認公司，搜尋或查看 SKU 與產品資料。
比對產品名稱、規格及庫存快照，需要序號或箱標時進入 SN 與標籤；匯入舊 ERP 庫存前確認目前公司，預覽後若切換公司須重新預覽。
boundaries: 庫存快照不等於實體盤點、預留量或已完成出庫；對外通用庫存調整、預留與釋放入口已關閉，正式銷單出庫須依交運核銷流程。
查詢需要庫存讀取權限；建倉與舊 ERP 匯入需要庫存更新權限，且只能操作授權公司。
商品清單與明細的成本欄位需另有 product_cost:read；只有庫存讀取權限不能查看成本，Copilot 查詢仍依原授權。

en.title: Products and inventory
en.summary: View SKUs, names, selling prices and inventory snapshots; cost fields require a separate cost-read grant.

steps: Confirm the company and find the SKU or product record.

Compare name, specification and stock snapshot; use SN and labels for serial or carton work. Confirm the selected company before previewing a legacy ERP stock import, and preview again if the company changes.
boundaries: A stock snapshot does not prove a physical count, reservation or completed dispatch. Generic HTTP stock adjustment, reservation and release endpoints are closed; final sales stock posting follows handover reconciliation.
Reads require inventory read permission. Warehouse creation and legacy ERP import require inventory update permission within an authorized company.
Product cost fields in lists and details require product_cost:read. Inventory read alone does not grant cost visibility; Copilot queries remain subject to their own authorization.

entries.title: 供應商管理
entries.summary: 依授權公司建立與維護供應商聯絡方式、統編及預設幣別。

steps: 先選擇公司，在供應商管理搜尋並比對名稱、統編與聯絡資訊，避免重複建檔。
有採購建立權限者可新增、修改或停用該公司供應商；採購或請款前，以原始文件核實交易幣別與收款資料。
boundaries: 停用供應商會保留既有採購歷史；供應商主檔不是付款完成證明。此頁不編輯收款帳戶，變更帳戶應依公司的核實流程。
可見供應商不代表可跨公司查詢或修改付款。

en.title: Vendors
en.summary: Create and maintain vendor contacts, tax IDs and default currencies within an authorized company.

steps: Select the company, then compare vendor names, tax IDs and contacts to avoid duplicates.
Staff with purchase creation access can add, change or deactivate a vendor in that company. Verify currency and payee details against original documents before purchase or payment.
boundaries: Deactivating a vendor preserves purchase history. A vendor record is not evidence of payment. This page does not edit bank accounts; verify changes through the company process.
Vendor visibility does not grant cross-company or payment-write access.

entries.title: 採購單
entries.summary: 建立與追蹤採購單，可依 B2B 人工核庫缺口建立來源關聯採購單，並於收貨前試算運費與到岸成本。

steps: 先選公司；有採購建立及成本更新權限者在採購單頁選擇該公司有效供應商與商品，填入日期、原幣單價、正整數數量、幣別與匯率後建立採購單。若選項缺少主檔，先到供應商或商品管理建檔。B2B 需求人工核庫不足時，可從獨立的「客戶缺貨採購」入口檢視缺口與既有關聯採購量，僅就尚未採購的缺口建立來源關聯採購單。
在待收貨採購單開啟「運費與到岸成本」，逐品項填本次總計費重量，輸入每公斤運費、運費幣別與必要匯率，先試算再保存估算。
選擇收貨倉庫並核對品項數量；需序號的商品填齊序號後確認收貨入庫，再查看已保存的成本分攤。若採購單來自 B2B 缺口，收貨後回客戶採購工作台重新人工核庫，確認可供量與交期。
boundaries: 運費與到岸成本在收貨前可修改；試算或保存估算都不增加庫存，收貨才建立庫存與成本紀錄，收貨後只能查看估算。
採購單、收貨、應付與付款不是同一狀態，不能只憑建立採購單認定已進貨；B2B 已收或取消的採購單不再占用未收缺口。若在上次核庫後收到關聯採購單，系統拒絕再採購，須先由業務重新人工核庫。來源關聯採購單不會自動出具報價或預留庫存。
建單與收貨需授權公司、採購建立及 product_cost:update；到岸成本試算需 product_cost:read，保存需 product_cost:update，收貨與到岸成本另受採購角色限制。採購文件中的成本與金額對未獲成本讀取權限者遮蔽。

en.title: Purchase orders
en.summary: Create and track purchase orders, including shortage-linked B2B procurement, then estimate freight and landed cost before receipt.

steps: Select the company. Staff with purchase creation and cost-update access choose an active vendor and products from that company, enter date, currency, exchange rate, unit costs and positive integer quantities, then create the purchase order. Create missing master records in Vendors or Products first. For a manually reviewed B2B shortage, use the separate Customer shortage procurement page to inspect each line's shortage and linked open-order quantity; create a source-linked supplier purchase order only for the unpurchased shortage.
On a pending order, open Landed cost, enter each line's total chargeable weight, freight per kilogram, currency and any exchange rate; preview and then save the estimate.

Choose the receiving warehouse and verify quantities. Enter serial numbers where required, receive the goods, and review the saved cost allocation. After receiving a B2B shortage-linked order, return to the customer procurement workbench for a fresh manual stock and delivery review.
boundaries: Landed cost can be changed before receipt. Previewing or saving an estimate does not add stock; receipt records inventory and cost, after which the estimate is read-only.

A purchase order, receipt, payable and payment have separate states; creation alone does not prove receipt. Received or cancelled linked orders no longer consume the open shortage. If a linked order arrived after the last stock review, a new purchase order is blocked until sales manually reviews stock again. A linked order does not automatically issue a quote or reserve inventory.

Creation and receipt require company access, purchase creation and product_cost:update. Landed-cost preview requires product_cost:read, saving requires product_cost:update, and receipt and landed-cost actions also retain a purchasing role gate. Cost and amount fields in purchase documents are hidden without cost-read access.

entries.title: 銀行帳務
entries.summary: 查看銀行帳戶餘額、資金流與對帳資訊。

steps: 選擇可見銀行帳戶，核對公司、幣別、餘額與交易日期。
處理對帳單前先查看匯入預覽；將交易與來源單據核對後再依授權對帳。
boundaries: 帳戶另有可見人員限制；資料範圍或銀行讀取權限不保證可查看每個帳戶。
匯入、對帳與付款記錄是不同動作；Copilot 目前的銀行工具只彙總系統已匯入交易淨額，不是銀行即時可用餘額，也不會執行付款。

en.title: Banking
en.summary: Review bank accounts, balances, transactions and reconciliation.

steps: Select a visible bank account and verify company, currency, balance and transaction date.
Preview a statement before import, then compare transactions with source documents before authorized reconciliation.
boundaries: Account-level visibility lists apply in addition to banking scopes and permissions.
Import, reconciliation and payment recording are distinct. The current Copilot bank tool totals imported transactions; it is not a live available bank balance and does not transfer funds.

entries.title: 員工部門與主管綁定
entries.summary: 在員工管理設定「所屬部門」與「部門主管」。部門設定可選共同作業角色及主管額外作業角色，主管保留部門共同作業，再加入額外功能。這些綁定須由有員工管理及帳號權限管理權限的人員維護。部門主管可查看本部門出勤與審核他人請假；薪資、財務、帳號管理及完整操作日誌不由部門角色自動授權。費用送審仍依「直屬主管」，已送出的申請不改派。

steps: 在部門設定選共同作業角色與主管額外角色，再編輯員工的所屬部門。
勾選「部門主管」後儲存；帳號與權限的「可見介面」會包含部門衍生權限。
如需費用審批，另選同公司、啟用且可存取費用的直屬主管。既有審批人不會自動更換。
boundaries: 未設定主管旗標的人員不會因職稱或角色名稱被推定為主管。調部門、取消主管或停用後，後端重新核對權限。
部門角色僅授予作業權限，個人明確授權仍保留；同仁薪資需 employee_compensation:read，薪酬修改另需 employee_compensation:update。財務與系統管理分別授權；不能審核自己的請假或費用。
部門主管身分不自動取得考績權；評核人須有主管考核職務權限，且由人資或獲授權管理者在週期中逐筆指派。

en.title: Employee department and supervisor binding
en.summary: Set Department and Department supervisor in the employee record. Shared department work permissions remain available to supervisors, who also receive configured additional operations and department attendance/leave review. Sensitive finance, salary, identity and audit access remain individual grants. Direct supervisors still route expenses; existing assignments do not change.

steps: Choose shared and additional supervisor work roles in department settings, then assign the employee department.
Enable Department supervisor and save. The access preview includes derived department permissions. Changes require employee management and access-management authority.
For expenses, separately choose an active same-company direct supervisor with expense access. Existing approval assignments are preserved.
boundaries: Titles or role names do not establish supervisor status. Transfers, demotion and deactivation are checked on subsequent server requests.

Department grants are operational and additive. Coworker pay requires employee_compensation:read and compensation changes also require employee_compensation:update; finance and system access remain separate. Self-approval is blocked.
Department supervisor status does not grant performance review access. The reviewer needs the review job permission and an explicit assignment in a cycle by HR or another authorized manager.

entries.title: 考績與主管考核
entries.summary: 在「考績與考核」查看週期及指派紀錄。人資或獲授權管理者建立週期時選公司、指派評核人；有考核職務權限的主管只處理明確指派給自己的紀錄。

steps: 人資或獲授權管理者選擇可存取公司、建立考核週期，再從同公司在職員工名單指派受評者及評核人。
系統預設使用受評者目前的直屬主管；建立指派時固定評核人，若需不同評核人須在指派時明確選擇。
評核人開啟指派給自己的草稿，填寫 1 到 5 分、目標與評語；送出前必須有評分及評語。
送出後查看狀態；已送出的考核不可再修改。
boundaries: 建立週期及指派需 performance_reviews:manage；評核人需明確的 performance_reviews:read 與 performance_reviews:write、連結同公司在職員工與啟用帳號。部門主管身分不會自動授權。
一般評核人只能查看及修改自己被指派的紀錄；跨公司、未指派、自評或已送出的修改均被拒絕。管理者可查看授權公司紀錄，但不能代改主管評語。
考績名單只含員工身分資料，不含薪資、銀行或薪酬；考績權限不授予 employee_compensation:read，也不代表薪資決策已完成。

en.title: Performance reviews
en.summary: In Performance reviews, view cycles and assignments. HR or another authorized manager chooses a company when creating a cycle and assigns reviewers; a supervisor with the review job grant handles only records explicitly assigned to them.

steps: HR or an authorized manager selects an accessible company, creates a cycle, then assigns a subject and reviewer from active employees in that company.
The current direct supervisor is the default reviewer. The reviewer is fixed when the assignment is created; choose another explicitly at assignment time if needed.
The reviewer opens an assigned draft and enters a score from 1 to 5, goals and comments. Score and comment are required before submission.
Check the submitted status. A submitted review cannot be edited.
boundaries: Creating cycles and assignments requires performance_reviews:manage. A reviewer needs explicit performance_reviews:read and performance_reviews:write, an active account and a linked active employee in the same company. Supervisor status alone grants nothing.

An ordinary reviewer can read and edit only their assigned records. Cross-company, unassigned, self-review and edits after submission are blocked. Managers can read records in accessible companies but cannot edit a supervisor’s comments on their behalf.
The roster contains employee identity only, with no salary, bank or compensation fields. Review access does not grant employee_compensation:read or complete a pay decision.

entries.title: 薪資管理
entries.summary: 查看薪資批次、薪資成本與員工薪資相關資料。

steps: 在薪資管理選擇月份或批次，檢查薪資項目及批次狀態。
有薪資管理及薪酬讀寫權限者依原流程計算、確認或核准；員工只從本人薪資單入口查看獲授權的個人內容。
boundaries: 計算、核准、過帳與實際發薪應分開核實。
查同仁薪資與銀行、薪酬欄位需 payroll_admin:read 及 employee_compensation:read；計算或更改需 payroll_admin:update 及 employee_compensation:update。個人薪資單走本人 payroll_self:read 路由；考績授權不開放薪資，Copilot 不能用一般指南取得他人資料。

en.title: Payroll
en.summary: Review payroll runs, costs and authorized employee pay information.

steps: Select the month or run and inspect payroll items and status.
Staff with payroll administration and compensation grants use the original calculation, confirmation and approval flow. Employees view only their authorized personal payslips.
boundaries: Calculation, approval, posting and actual disbursement require separate verification.

Coworker pay, bank and compensation fields require payroll_admin:read and employee_compensation:read; calculation or changes require payroll_admin:update and employee_compensation:update. Personal payslips use the employee’s own payroll_self:read route. Review permission does not grant salary, and Copilot cannot use a general guide to retrieve another person’s pay.

entries.title: 出勤與請假
entries.summary: 處理出勤、請假與人員日常出勤管理。

steps: 先確認帳號已連結有效員工，在我的出勤查看今日紀錄與個人假別資料。
按實際上下班時間使用打卡；加班申請填日期、分鐘數與原因並追蹤審核。
boundaries: 打卡規則會使用班表、位置與其他政策；載入失敗不表示無假期餘額。
AI 不能替代本人打卡或保證加班核准。

en.title: My attendance
en.summary: Manage daily attendance and personal leave-related information.

steps: Confirm an active employee link and review today’s records and personal leave information.
Clock in or out for actual attendance. Enter date, minutes and reason for overtime and track its review.
boundaries: Attendance uses schedule, location and other policies; a failed load is not a zero leave balance.
AI does not clock in for you or guarantee overtime approval.

entries.title: AI 助手原則
entries.summary: 核心原則是少即是多，大道至簡：先理解問題，再找最相關的資料與最短答案。

steps: 用具體問題說明要了解的功能、公司、日期或單號；操作指南會附可前往的功能入口。
需要即時數字時，先選定公司，依目前帳號可用的查詢工具取得資料。
核對引用來源及資料時間；問題超出已接入工具時，回到原功能查證。
boundaries: 操作知識涵蓋功能入口，不代表每個模組都已具備 AI 即時查詢或執行工具。
只有註冊且授權的工具可查資料；一般指南不授予權限，也不表示已核准、付款、發送或過帳。
Copilot 商品成本查詢另需 product_cost:read；同仁薪資彙總另需 employee_compensation:read。每日財務簡報需成本、毛利、淨利三項授權及相應公司的財務與銷售資料範圍，不能從一般指南推得可查。
不要貼上密碼、驗證碼、金鑰或不必要的個資；AI 無法連線時不得假装使用即時資料。

en.title: AI assistant principles
en.summary: Start by understanding the question, retrieve relevant evidence, and answer clearly and briefly.

steps: Ask a specific question with the feature, company, date or document reference; guides link to relevant features.
For current figures, select the company and use only queries available to your account.
Check source and date. When the question exceeds connected tools, verify it in the original feature.
boundaries: Coverage of operating guides does not mean every module has a live AI query or executor.
Only registered authorized tools may retrieve data. A guide grants no permission and proves no approval, payment, sending or posting.

Copilot product-cost lookup separately requires product_cost:read, and coworker payroll summary requires employee_compensation:read. The daily financial briefing requires cost, margin and net-profit grants plus matching company accounting and sales scope; a general guide does not confer any of these.
Do not share passwords, verification codes, keys or unnecessary personal data. A disconnected AI provider must not be presented as a live result.

entries.title: 儲運工作區
entries.summary: 依角色開放儲運工作站、收貨、揀貨、出貨與報表；WMS 實際交運仍須在 ERP 逐行核銷才正式扣庫。

steps: 從儲運工作台查看可用的作業與功能卡片。
已設定 WMS 入口時，點選需要的功能並使用目前營運帳號進入授權的 WMS；未連線時只依實際載入內容判讀。
WMS 完成實際交運並回傳物流與箱件證據後，到「交運待核銷」核對 ERP 銷單並逐行核准正式出庫。
boundaries: ERP 入口與 WMS 內部權限都需通過。各環境只能進入對應的允許來源。
裝箱完成不等於實際交運，更不等於 ERP 正式出庫；本目錄不保證 WMS 內部步驟或任務已完成。

en.title: Warehouse workspace
en.summary: Access authorized warehouse stations, receiving, picking, dispatch and reports. Actual WMS handover still needs line-by-line ERP reconciliation for final stock posting.

steps: Open the warehouse workspace to see available work and feature cards.
When a WMS portal is configured, open the relevant destination using the current operations account; otherwise rely only on actually loaded data.
After actual WMS handover supplies logistics and package evidence, compare it with the ERP sales order in Handover reconciliation and approve each line for final stock posting.
boundaries: Both ERP entry permissions and WMS permissions apply. Each environment only opens its allowlisted source.
Packing alone is neither actual handover nor final ERP stock posting. This catalog does not certify completion of internal WMS tasks.

entries.title: SN 序號與箱標
entries.summary: 在 SN 標籤頁建立序號批次、配對外箱並下載標籤。序號、箱號與產品必須可追溯；下載 PDF 不代表已完成工廠印刷或掃碼驗收。

steps: 選擇產品並填入批次資料，先檢查序號規則與標籤預覽。
有庫存修改權限者將草稿儲存成正式批次，再依批次進行箱號配對與標籤下載。
規格箱貼紙用箱號條碼掃描箱號；有 SN 版本的 QR Code 以半形逗號分隔箱內序號。核對匯出的箱號、序號與箱內順序，再進行實際列印與掃描驗收。
boundaries: 瀏覽器草稿與伺服器批次分開；看到預覽不表示已建立正式序號。
規格箱貼紙不印產品國際條碼，但產品資料與匯出明細仍保留該欄位。請保留 SKU、序號、箱號來源關係；目前指南不代表支援任意倉庫 Excel 匯入。

en.title: Serial numbers and carton labels
en.summary: Create serial batches, pair cartons and download labels with product and carton traceability. PDF export is not factory printing or scanner acceptance.

steps: Choose the product, fill in batch data and check serial rules and label preview.
With inventory-update access, save the draft as a persisted batch, then pair cartons and download labels.

Use the carton barcode to scan the carton ID. The QR Code on the SN carton label joins the serials with ASCII commas. Check exported carton IDs, serials and their order before physical printing and scanner acceptance.
boundaries: Browser drafts and persisted batches are distinct; a preview is not a registered serial batch.

The carton label omits the product barcode, while product data and detailed exports still retain it. Preserve SKU, serial and carton links. This guide does not imply arbitrary warehouse Excel import support.

entries.title: 會計工作台
entries.summary: 集中檢查來源單據、科目、傳票與差異。費用項目是員工申請選項，會計科目是入帳分類；分類不確定時交由會計確認，不可直接以 AI 建議當成正式入帳。

steps: 在會計工作台選擇資料範圍，查看來源單据與待辦。
由缺發票或差異追溯訂單、憑證、付款及傳票，確認歸屬日期與科目。
分類不確定時交由會計核實，再依正式入帳與核准流程處理。
boundaries: 報銷項目、憑證、應付、付款、會計分錄是不同資料層次。
AI 建議、核准費用或標記發票存在都不能單獨視為正式過帳。

en.title: Accounting workbench
en.summary: Review source documents, accounts, journals and differences. Expense items are employee choices; accounting accounts classify posting. Uncertain AI suggestions require accounting review.

steps: Select the data range in the accounting workbench and review source documents and pending work.
Trace missing invoices or differences to orders, evidence, payments and journals; verify dates and accounts.
Have accounting resolve uncertain classifications before formal posting and approval.
boundaries: Reimbursement items, evidence, payables, payments and journals represent different records.
AI suggestions, expense approval or an invoice-present flag alone do not prove formal posting.

entries.title: 對帳中心
entries.summary: 核對訂單、收款、發票、退款與手續費，依差異追溯來源單據。營收、收款、應收與銀行餘額的口徑不同，請以原單據及對帳狀態確認。

steps: 確認公司與日期範圍，查看各平台及來源的對帳摘要與差異。
由異常明細核對訂單、交易編號、收款、發票與退款；需要銀行資料時回到銀行帳務。
boundaries: 對帳、清帳與重跑同步是不同動作，可能需要 ADMIN 或 ACCOUNTANT；頁面讀取權限不足時由授權人員處理。
平台付款狀態不是銀行已入帳，超收或相同金額多筆需查證，不能直接刪除。

en.title: Reconciliation center
en.summary: Compare orders, receipts, invoices, refunds and fees, tracing differences to source documents. Revenue, receipts, receivables and bank balances are different measures.

steps: Confirm company and date range, then inspect summaries and differences by platform and source.
Trace exceptions through orders, transaction references, receipts, invoices and refunds; use Banking for account detail.
boundaries: Reconciliation, clearing and resync are distinct actions that may require ADMIN or ACCOUNTANT, beyond page access.
Platform payment status is not proof of bank settlement. Investigate overpayments or repeated amounts before altering records.

entries.title: 營運與財務報表
entries.summary: 依公司與日期區間查看報表，先確認資料來源、幣別與計算口徑。Copilot 目前支援單次授權資料查詢，尚未提供所有報表的跨模組分析。

steps: 在營運報表選擇公司、期間與需要的報表類型。
依獲授權欄位查看管理與電商歷史報表；完整損益、資產負債、現金流、試算與總分類帳需另有成本、毛利及淨利讀取權限。
追溯異常指標至來源明細，核對費用是否完整與期間是否一致。
boundaries: 報表平衡檢查不等於完成正式結帳；淨利受成本、應計與費用完整性影響。
統計口徑、幣別與日期區間不同時不可直接相加或比較。
報表讀取權限不等於可見成本、損益或可反推出費用的廣告費、平台費與淨入帳。product_cost:read 才可讀成本；毛利還需 financial_margin:read；淨利及上述費用相關指標還需 financial_net_profit:read。完整財務報表、月渠道與訂單對帳稽核，以及 AI 財務分析端點要求三者同時授權。

en.title: Operational and financial reports
en.summary: Select the company and date range, then verify source, currency and definitions. Copilot currently offers authorized individual queries, not every cross-module report analysis.

steps: Select company, period and report type.

Use management and ecommerce history views according to granted fields. Full income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, trial balance and general ledger also require cost, margin and net-profit read grants.
Trace unusual metrics to detail and verify expense completeness and consistent periods.
boundaries: A balanced report is not formal period close; profit depends on complete costs, accruals and expenses.
Do not combine or compare figures with incompatible definitions, currencies or date ranges.

Reports read access does not reveal cost, profit, or advertising spend, platform fees and net payout that could expose expenses. Cost requires product_cost:read, margin additionally needs financial_margin:read, and net profit and those expense-related metrics additionally need financial_net_profit:read. Full financial statements, monthly channel and order reconciliation audits, and AI financial analysis require all three grants.

entries.title: 個人資料
entries.summary: 由右上角帳號選單進入個人資料，確認自己的基本資料。需要調整角色、所屬公司、部門或直屬主管時，請具備人員管理權限的管理員處理。

steps: 由右上角帳號選單開啟個人資料，核對並儲存畫面允許修改的個人資料。
需要二階段驗證時由本人依頁面完成設定與驗證；到職文件依頁面下載或上傳。
boundaries: 角色、所屬公司、部門與主管由授權人員維護，個人頁面不會讓自己擴權。
不要把目前密碼、驗證碼、二階段驗證 QR 或備援資訊貼到 AI 對話。

en.title: My profile
en.summary: Use the account menu to view personal details. Authorized staff handle roles, company, department and supervisor changes.

steps: Open My profile from the account menu, review your information and save fields the page permits you to edit.
Set up two-factor verification yourself using the page instructions; download or upload onboarding documents where available.
boundaries: Authorized staff maintain roles, company, department and supervisor; the profile page does not grant self-escalation.
Never paste current passwords, verification codes, authenticator QR data or recovery information into AI chat.

entries.title: 請假申請
entries.summary: 在請假申請填寫假別、起迄日期及原因，送出後查看申請狀態；假別額度與審批結果以系統即時資料為準。

steps: 選擇假別與起迄時間，查看可用額度後填寫原因。
送出申請並於清單查看審核狀態；需要更正時依原頁面允許的流程處理。
boundaries: 假別額度以系統計算與人資核定為準，AI 不能保證可休或核准。
費用的直屬主管審批規則不能直接套用為請假審核規則。

en.title: Leave requests
en.summary: Enter the leave type, dates and reason, submit and track the request. Current balances and review results come from live system records.

steps: Choose the leave type and start/end time, check the balance and provide a reason.
Submit and track review status in the list; use the original page’s permitted correction workflow.
boundaries: Balances depend on system calculation and HR review; AI cannot promise availability or approval.
Do not assume expense supervisor-approval rules also govern leave review.

entries.title: 銷售報價
entries.summary: 建立與查看銷售報價；B2B 正式報價須由對應客戶明確接受有效版本。

steps: 以公司內的客戶搜尋選擇對象，設定報價日期、有效期限與幣別，填寫付款及交貨條件。
加入品項、數量與價格並儲存，開啟報價預覽後列印或存成 PDF。
由 B2B 客戶採購需求產生的正式報價，應在客戶採購工作台完成人工核庫後開立固定版本；既有客戶入口由客戶登入接受，免登入訪客需求則寄到已核實的目前客戶主檔信箱供客戶明確接受。若客戶已接受但尚未確認銷單，業務可在客戶採購工作台填原因撤回，重新人工核庫後再出新版。
boundaries: 內部備註與顧客列印備註用途不同；輸出前先檢查顧客版內容。
儲存或下載一般報價不表示已寄出、客戶接受、轉訂單或收到款項。B2B 正式報價的接受紀錄須由客戶登入或經核實 Email 的私密連結明確建立，員工不得在一般報價狀態欄代替客戶接受；寄出與瀏覽都不算接受。撤回原版保留歷史與原因，原客戶接受不得用來確認新銷單。

en.title: Sales quotations
en.summary: Create and view sales quotations; B2B formal quotes require explicit customer acceptance of a valid version.

steps: Search for a customer in the selected company, set the quotation date, validity and currency, then enter payment and delivery terms.
Add lines, quantities and prices, save, and open the preview to print or save a PDF.

For a formal quote sourced from a B2B customer request, first complete manual stock review and issue a fixed version from the customer procurement workbench. Existing portal customers sign in to accept; a no-login guest request uses a private link delivered to a verified current customer-master email for explicit acceptance. If accepted but not yet converted to an order, sales can record a reason and withdraw it, then manually re-review stock before issuing a new version.
boundaries: Internal notes and customer-facing print notes serve different purposes; inspect the customer view before export.

Saving or downloading a regular quotation does not prove sending, acceptance, order conversion or payment. B2B acceptance requires the signed-in customer or the verified-email private link and an explicit customer action; staff cannot mark it accepted through the general quotation status control. SMTP delivery and link viewing are not acceptance. A withdrawn version remains in history with its reason, and its former acceptance cannot authorize a new order.

entries.title: 售後案件工作台
entries.summary: 按案件類型與狀態追蹤售後來源、處理進度、待辦角色與承辦人。

steps: 選擇案件類型或狀態篩選，開啟案件詳情查看來源及進度。
新版工作台啟用時，維修、漏寄補寄、來回件、退款派車、私下購買與客戶問題共用此入口；需要報價時依已提供動作建立草稿。
boundaries: staged 功能未啟用的部署使用既有來回件頁面，可能沒有新版分類或草稿入口。
ERP 顯示來源資料不表示已在客服來源系統發送訊息、完成退款或實際取送件。

en.title: After-sales case workspace
en.summary: Track after-sales sources, progress, pending roles and owners by case type and status.

steps: Filter by case type or status and inspect the source and progress in case details.
When the staged workspace is enabled, repair, reshipment, exchange/return, refund pickup, private purchase and customer issues share this entry. Use the provided action to prepare a quote draft.
boundaries: Deployments without staged features show the existing case page and may lack the newer categories or draft entry.
Displayed source data does not prove a message was sent, a refund completed or a pickup/delivery performed in the source system.

entries.title: 售後案件報價草稿
entries.summary: 為既有維修案件選擇品牌、編寫報價項目並保存未發送的草稿。

steps: 在已啟用新版售後功能的部署，由案件建立報價草稿或在案件報價頁新增。
選擇維修案件及品牌，核對項目、數量、單價與顧客說明，查看顧客版預覽後保存草稿。
boundaries: 此功能受 staged 開關控制，未啟用時會導回售後案件頁。
顧客版預覽明確標示未發送；保存草稿不會寄送報價，也不等於客戶確認。

en.title: After-sales quote drafts
en.summary: Choose a brand for a repair case, prepare quote lines and save an unsent draft.

steps: In a deployment with staged after-sales enabled, create a draft from a case or the case-quote page.
Choose the repair case and brand, check lines, quantities, prices and customer note, preview the customer version and save the draft.
boundaries: This route requires the staged feature; otherwise it redirects to the case page.
The customer preview is explicitly unsent. Saving a draft neither sends a quote nor records customer acceptance.

entries.title: 內部售後案件
entries.summary: 查看與維護 ERP 內部的來回件及售後處理紀錄。

steps: 進入內部案件清單，依案件種類或狀態找到需要處理的案件。
開啟案件核對客戶、品項、付款與倉庫進度，再依有權限的原頁面動作處理。
boundaries: 內部案件與外部客服來源案件可能使用不同識別及狀態，請先確認來源。
沒有來源回執不能認定已發送、出貨、退款或開票。

en.title: Internal after-sales cases
en.summary: View and maintain internal ERP exchange/return and after-sales records.

steps: Open the internal case list and locate a record by type or status.
Inspect customer, lines, payment and warehouse progress before using authorized page actions.
boundaries: Internal and externally sourced cases may use different identifiers and statuses; check the source first.
Without source confirmation, do not claim sending, shipping, refunding or invoicing is complete.

entries.title: 售後品牌設定
entries.summary: 維護售後報價使用的品牌設定，保存時保留版本檢查。

steps: 在已啟用新版售後功能的部署，由管理員開啟品牌設定並載入現有版本。
編輯需要的品牌資訊後保存；如果版本衝突，先重新載入並核對他人的修改。
boundaries: 此頁限管理員，並受 staged 開關控制；未啟用時導回售後案件。
品牌設定與案件報價草稿不會自動發送到顧客。

en.title: After-sales brand settings
en.summary: Maintain brand settings used by after-sales quotes, with version checks when saving.

steps: In a staged-enabled deployment, an administrator opens brand settings and loads the existing version.
Edit the necessary brand information and save; on a version conflict, reload and inspect concurrent changes.
boundaries: The page is administrator-only and gated by the staged feature; otherwise it redirects to cases.
Brand settings and case quote drafts do not automatically send anything to customers.

entries.title: 應收帳款與收款
entries.summary: 查看訂單應收、收款與發票，追蹤超收或疑似重複收款。

steps: 選擇日期區間查看未收應收、金流費用及發票狀態。
B2B 應收需填客戶、對帳單號、金額與到期日；有實際入款後才記錄收款。
發現超收時開啟明細，依付款批次與交易編號比對，可匯出審核清單。
boundaries: 超收或相同金額不必然是重複交易，可能是合併收款，必須核實。
查詢金流狀態、同步資料與記錄收款不同；Copilot 不會代替這些写入操作。

en.title: Receivables and receipts
en.summary: Review order receivables, payments and invoices, including overpayment or possible duplicate receipts.

steps: Select a date range and review open receivables, payment fees and invoice status.
For a B2B receivable, enter customer, statement reference, amount and due date; record a receipt only after actual payment.
Inspect overpayment details by payment batch and transaction reference, exporting the review list if needed.
boundaries: An overpayment or repeated amount may be a combined payment rather than a duplicate; investigate.
Provider status lookup, sync and receipt recording are distinct; Copilot does not execute these writes.

entries.title: 會計科目表
entries.summary: 查看科目代碼、名稱、類別、幣別餘額與啟用狀態。

steps: 開啟會計科目表並重新載入目前公司科目。
依科目代碼、名稱與類別核對要使用的科目，再到分錄或報銷項目處理分類。
boundaries: 目前「新增科目」按鈕與搜尋框尚未接上操作事件，不可描述為已完成新增或篩選功能。
科目主檔與正式過帳餘額需配合總分類帳、日期及幣別核對。

en.title: Chart of accounts
en.summary: Review account codes, names, types, currency balances and active status.

steps: Open the chart of accounts and reload accounts for the current company.
Check code, name and type, then use the appropriate account in journals or reimbursement setup.
boundaries: The current Add account button and search field have no connected action; do not describe them as working creation or filtering features.
Reconcile account records and posted balances with the ledger, date range and currency.

entries.title: 會計分錄
entries.summary: 建立與檢查手動分錄，依權限完成核准。

steps: 查詢分錄並核對傳票日期、摘要及狀態。
有新增權限時填日期、摘要與各行借貸科目金額，核對平衡後提交。
核准人需檢查來源憑證、科目及期間，再使用原頁面核准動作。
boundaries: 讀取、新增、核准分錄是獨立權限；借貸平衡不等於分類或稅務正確。
AI 或費用核准建議不能直接替代會計核准與入帳。

en.title: Journal entries
en.summary: Create and inspect manual journals and approve them where authorized.

steps: Find the journal and inspect its date, description and status.
With create access, enter date, description and debit/credit lines, verify balance and submit.
An approver checks source evidence, accounts and period before approving through the original page.
boundaries: Read, create and approve are separate permissions; balance alone does not prove correct classification or tax treatment.
AI advice and expense approval do not replace accounting approval or posting.

entries.title: 會計期間與關鎖帳
entries.summary: 查看期間狀態，由管理員依序執行關帳與鎖帳。

steps: 使用全部、開放、已結帳、已鎖定篩選期間，核對起迄日期。
管理員完成必要會計檢核後，對開放期間執行關帳，再對已結帳期間執行鎖帳。
boundaries: 只有 ADMIN 或 SUPER_ADMIN 可呼叫關帳與鎖帳；可讀取期間不代表可關帳。
本頁沒有解鎖或自動修正漏帳的操作；先核對單據完整性。

en.title: Accounting periods and closing
en.summary: View accounting-period status; administrators close and lock periods in sequence.

steps: Filter all, open, closed or locked periods and verify their dates.
After required accounting checks, an administrator closes an open period, then locks a closed period.
boundaries: Closing and locking require ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN, beyond period-read access.
This page has no unlock or automatic missing-entry repair action; check document completeness first.

entries.title: 逾期對帳追蹤
entries.summary: 查看逾期案件、維護付款連結與備註，依流程交回會計。

steps: 開啟逾期對帳案件，核對訂單、付款狀態與既有追蹤紀錄。
必要時維護付款連結或備註；需退回會計時填原因與說明。
重送付款連結會使用原系統的明確動作，執行前核對對象與內容。
boundaries: API 另限制 ADMIN、ACCOUNTANT 或 CUSTOMER_SERVICE；一般頁面可見權限不保證可執行全部操作。
AI 操作說明不會代發付款提醒；DEV 沙盒可能封鎖外部發送。

en.title: Overdue reconciliation follow-up
en.summary: Review overdue cases, maintain payment links and notes, and return cases to accounting.

steps: Inspect the overdue case, order, payment status and follow-up history.
Maintain the payment link or notes where needed; include a reason when returning it to accounting.
Resending a payment link is an explicit original-system action; verify recipient and content first.
boundaries: The API additionally restricts access to ADMIN, ACCOUNTANT or CUSTOMER_SERVICE; page visibility alone does not authorize every action.
AI guidance does not send reminders; the DEV sandbox may block external delivery.

entries.title: 出勤審核與班表政策
entries.summary: 部門主管可查看本部門出勤並審核請假；另有出勤管理權限的人員可操作加班、班表政策及年度額度。

steps: 部門主管進入後使用簡化的「部門出勤」，選月份查看紀錄；請假列表按年度顯示，核對原因與時數後逐筆審核。
選擇日期、員工及出勤類型，查看明細及待審假單或加班。
核對原因與時數後逐筆或依頁面提供的批次動作審核。
具修改權限者可維護班表、打卡政策、統一放假宣告與年度額度；保存後核對適用對象。
boundaries: 部門主管的 attendance_team 權限只開放部門出勤與請假審核，不含全公司政策、額度調整、加班覆核或薪資。自己的請假須由其他有權限的人員審核。
人工補正、加班核准與薪資計算是不同狀態，不應自動推定已發薪。

en.title: Attendance review and policies
en.summary: Department supervisors see scoped attendance and review leave. Separate attendance administration grants govern overtime, policies and balances.

steps: Department supervisors use the simplified team view: select a month for attendance; leave is listed for that year and reviewed individually.
Filter date, employee and attendance type to inspect records and pending leave or overtime.
Check reasons and hours before individual review or available bulk review.
With update access, maintain schedules, clocking policies, closures and annual balances, then verify who they apply to.
boundaries: Team permissions only cover scoped attendance and leave review. Policy, balance, overtime and payroll rights require separate grants. Self-approval is not permitted.
Manual adjustments, overtime approval and payroll calculation are distinct states and do not prove disbursement.

entries.title: 組裝工單
entries.summary: 查看組裝工單編號、產品、預計產量及狀態。

steps: 開啟組裝與製造頁，使用重新整理載入工單。
核對生產產品、預計產量、狀態與開始日期，必要時由授權作業人員追溯原工單。
boundaries: 目前「建立工單」按鈕沒有接上表單或事件；頁面只能依已載入工單查閱，不能宣稱可完成建立。
後端另有 ADMIN／ACCOUNTANT／OPERATOR 角色要求；庫存頁面權限不等於執行組裝權限。

en.title: Assembly orders
en.summary: View assembly order numbers, products, planned quantities and status.

steps: Open Assembly and manufacturing and refresh the order list.
Check product, planned quantity, status and start date; have an authorized operator trace the source order as needed.
boundaries: The current Create order button has no form or handler; the page supports viewing loaded orders, not a completed creation flow.
The backend additionally checks ADMIN, ACCOUNTANT or OPERATOR roles; inventory page access does not authorize assembly execution.

entries.title: 公司管理
entries.summary: 由最高管理員維護公司登入代碼、基本資料、幣別及啟用狀態。

steps: 最高管理員開啟公司管理，確認要新增或編輯的公司。
填寫登入代碼、名稱、國別、基準幣別及必要聯絡資料；核對後儲存。
建立初始管理員時依表單填寫必要資訊，另行安全交付初始登入資訊。
boundaries: 限 SUPER_ADMIN；一般 ADMIN 不能藉由知識指南建立公司或取得其他公司資料。
停用公司會影響登入與業務存取，先確認目標；不要把初始密碼貼入對話。

en.title: Company management
en.summary: Super administrators maintain company login codes, details, currency and active status.

steps: A super administrator opens company management and identifies the company to create or edit.
Enter login code, name, country, base currency and required contacts, verify and save.
When creating an initial administrator, fill required fields and deliver initial login information through a secure separate process.
boundaries: Only SUPER_ADMIN may manage companies; a guide does not grant ordinary admins company creation or cross-company access.
Disabling a company affects access. Verify the target and never paste initial passwords into chat.
