entries.title: 免登入商品採購需求
entries.summary: 訪客依品牌、分類及搜尋挑選公開商品，僅看建議售價並取得可分享的待核實採購單。

steps: 訪客在公開商品頁依業務設定的品牌、分類或關鍵字搜尋已上架且另經匿名公開勾選的商品，只看到建議售價及參考金額；選品後填公司、聯絡人、Email、可選採購單號及需求，送出取得可分享的採購單連結。
公開採購單只顯示品項、數量、牌價與受理狀態；員工到客戶採購工作台的免登入訪客需求分頁查看聯絡資料，透過既有管道核實身分並記錄依據，配對客戶主檔，再明確選擇品項、數量與未稅單價轉為內部待核庫需求。
boundaries: 公開頁不顯示客戶固定價、折數、團購主進貨價、活動價、成本或精確庫存。建議售價與小計不是正式報價，也不保證庫存或交期；送出需求不建立銷貨單、不預留或扣庫。
公開商品 API、公開送單及每商品匿名發布各有獨立開關與限制，公開送單須先驗證代理來源與限流。採購單連結與受理編號不是查看私人價格的憑證；已配對或標記無效的需求不能在原操作中重新配對。員工配對主檔不會自動建立內部需求、正式報價或銷單；轉內部需求也不代表庫存已確認。

en.title: Guest product purchase requests
en.summary: Visitors browse public products by brand, category or search, see only MSRP and receive a shareable pending purchase receipt.

steps: Visitors browse products published and separately opted in for anonymous display by staff-set brand, category or keyword. They see only MSRP and reference amounts, choose quantities, enter company and contact details, optional customer PO and notes, then receive a shareable purchase receipt link.

The public receipt shows only items, quantities, MSRP and intake status. Staff open Guest inquiries in the procurement workbench, verify the sender through an established channel, record the evidence, match an existing customer record, then explicitly select lines, quantities and pre-tax unit prices to create an internal request pending manual stock review.
boundaries: The public page does not disclose fixed customer prices, multipliers, group-buy organizer prices, campaigns, costs or exact stock. MSRP totals are not formal quotations or stock promises; submission creates no sales order, reservation or inventory deduction.

Anonymous catalog access, guest submission and each product's public opt-in have separate gates. Public submission requires validated ingress identity and abuse limits. A receipt reference grants no access to private pricing. A matched or rejected inquiry cannot be silently rematched through the original action. Matching alone creates no internal request, formal quote or sales order; conversion still does not confirm stock.

entries.title: 免登入專屬報價確認
entries.summary: 訪客需求經人工核庫與收件信箱核實後，由客戶以限時私密連結查看並明確接受固定版次報價。

steps: 員工將已核實訪客採購單明確轉為內部需求，完成逐項人工核庫，確認本次數量、未稅價格、交期及條件後出具不可改寫的正式報價版次。
員工核對收件地址與目前啟用的客戶主檔 Email 或對帳 Email 相同，記錄查核依據，再由系統寄出私密報價連結；LINE 群組僅提醒查收 Email。
客戶從 Email 開啟限時連結，核對版次、買賣方、商品、數量、價格、總額及條件；同意時明確按「確認接受」。業務收到接受紀錄後仍須在 ERP 確認接單。
boundaries: 私密連結可被轉寄，持有者可看報價；不得貼在 LINE 群組。連結 24 小時內到期，且不得超過報價有效期限；新版、撤回、逾期或失去客戶信箱對應的連結不能再用。系統只儲存憑證雜湊，不在員工回應中提供連結或原始憑證。
寄送到 SMTP、開啟連結與客戶明確接受是不同狀態。接受仍不建立銷貨單或預留庫存；業務確認接單後才依接受版快照建立銷單及預留。公開採購單連結不能查看此專屬價格。
此本地開發流程的公開入口、匿名送單與私密 Email 開關預設關閉，尚未在 DEV 做真實收件與代理限流驗收；不可宣稱目前網站已可使用。

en.title: No-login private quote acceptance
en.summary: After manual stock and recipient-email verification, a guest customer reviews and explicitly accepts a fixed quote version through a time-limited private link.

steps: Staff explicitly convert a verified guest receipt to an internal request, review stock line by line, confirm the current quantities, pre-tax prices, delivery and terms, then issue an immutable formal quote version.

Staff verify that the recipient equals the current active customer master email or statement email, record their verification evidence, and send the private quote through the system. Use LINE only to remind the customer to check email.

The customer opens the time-limited email link, checks version, seller and buyer, items, quantities, prices, total and terms, then explicitly selects Accept. Sales still confirms the ERP order after the acceptance record exists.
boundaries: A forwarded private link lets its holder view the quote; never paste it into a LINE group. It expires within 24 hours and by the quote validity cutoff. Superseded, withdrawn, expired or no-longer-matched customer-email links cannot be used. Only a token hash is stored; staff responses never contain the raw token or link.

SMTP acceptance, link viewing and explicit customer acceptance are distinct states. Acceptance itself creates no sales order or reservation; sales confirmation then copies the accepted version into the order and reserves stock. The public purchase receipt cannot reveal private prices.

This locally developed flow's public catalog, anonymous submission and private email switches default off; real DEV mail and ingress-limit checks remain outstanding. Do not tell customers the live website already supports it.

entries.title: 客戶採購入口與商品目錄
entries.summary: 客戶用公司代碼與專屬帳號登入，查看已發布商品及適用於自己的價格。

steps: 由員工在客戶採購工作台建立客戶帳號，提供所屬公司登入代碼；客戶以公司代碼、電子郵件與密碼登入獨立入口。
客戶在商品目錄搜尋已發布品項、查看本公司適用的未稅台幣價格，填入採購數量與客戶採購單號。
boundaries: 客戶入口使用獨立登入及公司資料隔離；ERP 員工帳號與客戶帳號不能互用，商品與價格只顯示授權客戶可見的內容。
目錄價格與金額試算不保證現貨或交期。客戶自行重設密碼及供應商登入入口尚未提供，需洽業務窗口。

en.title: Customer procurement portal and catalog
en.summary: Customers sign in with a company code and dedicated account to view published products and their applicable prices.

steps: Staff create a customer account in the procurement workbench and provide the company's login code. The customer signs in with that code, email and password through a separate portal.
The customer searches published products, sees their applicable pre-tax TWD prices, and enters quantities and their purchase order number.
boundaries: Customer sessions and company data are separate from ERP employee access. The accounts are not interchangeable; only products and prices authorized for that customer are shown.
Catalog prices and totals do not guarantee availability or delivery. Customer self-service password reset and a supplier login portal are not yet available; contact the sales representative.

entries.title: 客戶採購需求與正式報價
entries.summary: 客戶先送出採購需求並追蹤人工核庫；員工出具正式報價後，再登入查看與接受有效版本。

steps: 在客戶商品目錄選擇數量、填入客戶採購單號及備註，送出後取得採購需求編號與價格試算；可複製需登入的需求討論連結至 LINE 與業務討論。
於「我的採購需求」查看逐行人工核庫狀態、價格快照、確認數量與交期。員工完成全數核庫並出具正式報價後，開啟最新版連結，核對報價日期、買賣雙方、固定品項、價格、總額、條件、交期與有效期限，再按「確認接受此版正式報價」。
boundaries: 新需求與需求討論連結僅是價格試算；送出、分享、出具正式報價或客戶接受均不預留或扣除庫存，也不等於 ERP 已確認接單。接受後仍由業務確認銷單，才建立庫存預留。
正式報價連結需要客戶登入且只能查看所屬公司資料；過期、被新版取代或由業務撤回的報價不能接受。已接受但尚未接單的報價若被撤回，原連結保留撤回原因，業務須重新人工核庫並出新版；原需求價格快照不會因日後改價而自動改寫。業務調整報價數量或單價時，已送出的舊版仍保留快照；確認接單只取客戶接受版次的價格與數量。

en.title: Customer purchase requests and formal quotes
en.summary: Customers submit purchase requests and follow manual stock review, then sign in to view and accept a valid issued quote version.

steps: Choose quantities in the customer catalog, enter the customer PO number and notes, and submit to receive a request number and price estimate. Copy the login-protected request link to discuss it with sales through LINE.

In My purchase requests, review line-by-line manual stock status, snapshotted prices, confirmed quantities and delivery date. Once staff fully review stock and issue a formal quote, open the latest version, inspect its quotation date, seller and buyer, fixed lines, prices, total, terms, delivery date and expiry, then explicitly accept that version.
boundaries: A new request and discussion link are only a price estimate. Submitting, sharing, issuing a formal quote or accepting it neither reserves nor deducts stock and does not confirm an ERP order. Sales must still confirm the order before reservation is created.

The formal quote link requires customer login and is scoped to the customer's company. Expired, superseded or withdrawn versions cannot be accepted. An accepted quote withdrawn before order confirmation remains visible with its reason; sales must manually re-review stock and issue a new version. Later price edits do not rewrite the request's price snapshot. Staff changes to quoted quantities or unit prices preserve prior issued versions; order confirmation uses only the customer's accepted version.

entries.title: 客戶採購工作台
entries.summary: 員工管理外部帳號、商品價目與客戶折數，人工核庫後出具固定版次報價；客戶接受後才確認 ERP 銷單。

steps: 先選公司；若客戶或供應商尚無主檔，先到客戶管理或供應商管理建立，再回此工作台搜尋主檔並建立綁定的外部帳號。搜尋商品發布與既有客戶固定單價仍各自管理；另在「商品牌價與活動」設定品牌、建議售價、常態售價、團購主進貨價、活動期間及稅別，在「客戶成交比例」設定代理商等客戶的常用折數並試算。免登入訪客需求須另在專用分頁人工核實聯絡人並配對客戶主檔，再選品項、數量與本次未稅價格，明確轉為內部待核庫需求。
收到需求後參考 ERP 各倉的在庫、已預留與可用量，逐行人工核對庫存，填入確認數量、交期與必要備註；既有登入需求可複製討論連結至 LINE，訪客的公開採購單連結也可供群組討論。若訪客內部需求缺貨，尚未出具任何報價或關聯採購單時，可依協調結果減量或刪除品項並記錄原因，之後重新人工核庫。具採購建立權限者另可在「客戶缺貨採購」入口核對未收採購量，選供應商建立來源關聯採購單；收貨後仍須重新核庫。
逐行全數確認後，可先明確帶入該顧客常用價格，再按本次需求調整原品項的數量及未稅單價、有效期限與付款交貨條件；出具後形成固定版本。既有客戶入口可複製需登入的正式報價連結；訪客需求則須核對目前客戶主檔收件信箱、記錄查核依據並由系統寄送私密連結，客戶免登入明確接受。已送出版本的價格或條件若變更，出具新版並保留舊版。若已接受而尚未接單，業務可填撤回原因使需求回待核庫；重新核庫後再出新版。
客戶接受最新有效版本後，選擇銷售通路與出貨倉庫確認接單；ERP 銷售訂單取用已接受報價的數量及金額快照，才預留庫存並開始 WMS 出貨交接。
boundaries: 既有 SKU 專屬固定價的「有效至」為台灣日期，設定當天結束前仍有效；隔日零時起不再套用該固定價。建議售價、常態售價及團購主進貨價有獨立價目；活動須核對期間與適用對象。未核實團購主身分時，團購價僅供內部參考，不會自動和代理商折數疊加。匿名公開需全域開關、每商品的獨立公開勾選和既有目錄發布都成立；品牌須人工設定，登入目錄的發布本身不會開放匿名瀏覽。免登入送單另需獨立開關與經驗證的防濫用設定；公開採購單連結只含牌價與品項，訪客配對或轉內部需求都不會自動建立正式報價或銷單。
ERP 庫存摘要只供員工人工判斷，頁面不顯示成本；人工核庫、訪客需求修訂、來源關聯採購單與出具正式報價都不預留、不扣 Corely ERP 正式庫存。訪客修訂保留原始採購單與核庫歷史，只有缺貨狀態、未出過任何報價且沒有關聯採購單時可減量或刪除品項；修訂後必須重新核庫。已收或取消採購不占未收缺口，收貨後若未重核庫，新增來源關聯採購會被拒絕。數量有異動時必填核對備註，不能直接確認接單。
已送出的正式報價固定品項、金額與條件；調整本次報價數量或未稅單價須出具新版，增列商品仍須新需求。被新版取代、過期或撤回版本不能接受。訪客版私密連結只寄至已核實的客戶主檔信箱，不能張貼 LINE 群組；寄送與瀏覽不是接受。員工無法代客戶接受，客戶接受後仍須業務確認接單才預留庫存；已接單不得撤回原報價。含稅牌價缺少已核准的換算規則時，不能自動帶入未稅正式報價。
客戶帳號使用獨立登入。供應商帳號可在獨立採購入口建檔、停用與重設密碼，供應商登入及查採購單尚未開放；供應商帳號變更需採購建立權限。
員工建立帳號時的初始密碼不會在頁面持續顯示；此工作台不會直接發送 LINE 訊息或證明 WMS 已出貨。

en.title: Customer procurement workbench
en.summary: Staff manage external accounts, product price books and customer discounts, issue fixed quote versions after manual stock review, and confirm ERP sales orders only after customer acceptance.

steps: Select a company. Create missing customer or vendor master records on their respective pages, then search for them and create linked external accounts in this workbench. Search for products to publish the catalog; catalog publishing and existing fixed customer SKU prices remain separate. In Product price books, set staff-reviewed brands, independent MSRP, regular price and the standing group-buy organizer procurement price, plus dated campaigns and explicit tax basis; in Customer discount ratios, set and preview a wholesale customer's usual multiplier. Separately verify and match guest inquiries, then explicitly select lines, quantities and current pre-tax prices to create an internal request pending stock review.

Use ERP per-warehouse on-hand, allocated and available quantities as a reference, then manually review each request line and record confirmed quantities, delivery date and required notes. Use the login-protected portal request link or the guest public purchase receipt in LINE for discussion. If a guest internal request has a shortage, staff can reduce or remove lines with a recorded reason before any quote or linked purchase order exists, then manually re-review stock. Staff with purchase creation access can separately inspect the unpurchased shortage and create a source-linked supplier purchase order; after receipt, review stock again.

After every line is confirmed, explicitly apply the customer's usual price if appropriate, then adjust request-line quantities, pre-tax unit prices, expiry and terms for this quote. Issuing freezes a version. Existing portal customers sign in through their formal quote link; guest requests require staff to verify a current customer-master recipient email, record why it was verified and send a private link for explicit no-login acceptance. Price or term changes after issue create a new version and preserve the old one. If accepted but not yet converted to an order, sales can record a withdrawal reason; this returns the request to manual stock review before a new version is issued.

After the customer accepts the latest valid version, choose a sales channel and shipping warehouse. The ERP sales order copies the accepted quotation's quantity and amount snapshots, then reserves inventory and starts WMS fulfilment handoff.
boundaries: The existing fixed SKU price's Valid through date is a Taiwan calendar date. It remains effective through that day, then expires. MSRP, regular price and the group-buy organizer procurement price have a separate price book; campaigns require the proper period and audience. The organizer price remains staff-only until verified and does not automatically stack with wholesale discounts. Anonymous publication requires the global enable flag, an explicit per-product public opt-in and existing catalog publication. Brands are staff-set; publishing to the signed-in catalog alone never exposes a product anonymously. Guest submission has a separate enable flag and verified abuse controls; a public receipt contains only MSRP and items, while guest matching or conversion creates no formal quote or sales order.

The ERP stock summary is staff-only reference data and contains no cost. Manual review, guest correction, a source-linked purchase order and quote issuance do not reserve or deduct Corely ERP's posted inventory. A guest correction preserves the original receipt and review history; it can only reduce or remove lines after a shortage review, before any quote or linked purchase order, and requires a new manual review. Received or cancelled orders no longer consume the open shortage; a new linked order is blocked after receipt until staff manually re-review stock. Quantity changes require a review note and cannot be directly confirmed as an order.

An issued formal quote fixes its lines, prices and terms. Editing current quote quantities or pre-tax unit prices requires a new version; adding products still requires a new request. Superseded, expired or withdrawn versions cannot be accepted, and staff cannot accept on the customer's behalf. Guest private links are mailed only to verified current customer-master addresses, never pasted into LINE; delivery and viewing are not acceptance. Customer acceptance still requires sales confirmation before reservation, and an already confirmed order cannot have its quote withdrawn. Tax-inclusive list prices cannot auto-populate a pre-tax quote without an approved conversion rule.

Customer accounts have a separate login. Supplier accounts can be created, deactivated and reset through a separate purchasing page, but supplier login and purchase-order viewing are not open; supplier account changes require purchase creation access.
The initial password does not remain visible on the page. This workbench does not send LINE messages or prove WMS shipment.

entries.title: 客戶缺貨採購
entries.summary: 採購人員檢視已人工核庫的 B2B 缺口，建立保留需求行來源的供應商採購單。

steps: 先選事業別，在「客戶缺貨採購」查看已由業務人工核庫且數量不足的需求；展開需求號，核對 SKU、品名、申購量、已確認量與缺口。
開啟需求並核對關聯採購單及每行未收採購量，選有效供應商、日期、幣別與匯率，逐行填寫不超過剩餘缺口的數量與原幣成本後建立採購單。
在採購單頁完成運費暫估與入庫；收貨後請業務重新人工核庫，再決定是否尚需採購或可以出具正式報價。
boundaries: 此入口需授權公司之採購建立權限，只顯示採購所需的需求號與品項數量，不顯示客戶登入帳號或專屬銷價。供應商主檔需先由授權人員建立。
只計未收且未取消的來源關聯採購量。若關聯採購在上次核庫後收貨，新建採購會被阻擋，不能把舊缺口直接再開單；須先由業務重新核庫。重送相同請求鍵與內容會返回原採購單。
建立採購單不等於入庫、客戶庫存確認、正式報價、銷單預留或付款；Corely ERP 收貨入庫才增加正式庫存。

en.title: Customer shortage procurement
en.summary: Purchasing staff review manually checked B2B shortages and create supplier purchase orders linked to the source request lines.

steps: Select the company. On Customer shortage procurement, review requests that sales manually marked short. Expand a request number and compare SKU, item name, requested quantity, confirmed quantity and shortage.

Open the request and inspect linked purchase orders and each line's open ordered quantity. Choose an active vendor, date, currency and exchange rate; enter original-currency costs and quantities within each remaining shortage, then create the supplier purchase order.
On the purchase-order page, estimate freight and receive stock. After receipt, ask sales to manually review stock again before deciding whether more procurement or a formal quote is appropriate.
boundaries: This page requires purchase creation permission in the selected company. It shows request numbers and item quantities needed by purchasing, not customer login accounts or private sales prices. Authorized staff must create the vendor master record first.

Only linked orders that are neither received nor cancelled consume the open shortage. Receipt after the last stock review blocks another linked order until sales reviews stock again; do not reuse the old shortage. Replaying the same request key and body returns the original purchase order.
Creating a purchase order is not receipt, customer stock confirmation, a formal quote, sales reservation or payment. Only receipt in Corely ERP increases posted inventory.

entries.title: 供應商帳號
entries.summary: 採購人員檢視供應商聯絡帳號，依權限建立、啟停與設定新密碼；供應商自助入口尚未開放。

steps: 選擇事業別，在「供應商帳號」查看供應商、聯絡人姓名、Email 與啟用狀態；若缺少供應商主檔，先請有權限的人員在供應商管理建立。
具採購建立權限者可選擇有效供應商並填姓名、Email 與至少 12 字元的新密碼建立帳號；也可停用、重新啟用或替既有帳號設定新密碼。
初始或重設密碼不在頁面持續顯示，須透過既有安全流程交付；重設後原登入憑證失效。
boundaries: 查看需所選公司採購讀取權限；建立、啟停與重設另需採購建立權限，且限授權公司。清單不提供客戶帳號、專屬銷價或密碼雜湊。
供應商帳號目前只是管理資料，尚不能登入客戶採購前台，也沒有供應商自助登入或採購單查詢入口；建立帳號不表示採購單已寄送或供應商已接單。

en.title: Supplier accounts
en.summary: Purchasing staff view supplier contact accounts and, with the required permission, create, enable, disable or reset them. Supplier self-service is not open.

steps: Select the company and open Supplier accounts to view vendor, contact name, email and active status. If the vendor master record is missing, authorized staff create it in Vendors first.

Staff with purchase creation permission can choose an active vendor and enter a name, email and new password of at least 12 characters to create an account. They can also deactivate, reactivate or set a new password for an existing account.
Initial and reset passwords are not kept visible on the page; deliver them through the established secure process. A reset revokes old sessions.
boundaries: Viewing requires purchase read permission for the selected company; creation, status changes and resets additionally require purchase creation permission. The list contains no customer accounts, private sales prices or password hashes.

Supplier accounts are currently administrative records: they cannot access the customer purchasing portal, and supplier self-service sign-in or purchase-order viewing is not available. Creating an account does not send a PO or prove supplier acceptance.

entries.title: 交運待核銷與正式出庫
entries.summary: 核對 WMS 實際交運、箱件與物流證據及 ERP 銷單，逐行人工核准正式扣庫。

steps: 選公司後篩選待核銷、已過帳或全部事件，亦可按台灣交運日期、訂單號、事件 ID 或 SKU 查找。
打開交運事件，逐行比較銷單量、先前已過帳量與本次實際交運量，核對箱件數量、交運方式、承運商及物流單號或清單。
具庫存更新權限的人員確認證據與數量後，按明細逐行核准過帳；遇來源、預留或庫存異動提示時重新整理並調查。
boundaries: 裝箱完成不會列為已交運，也不會正式扣庫；只有 WMS 實際交運事件且有箱件與物流證據才進待核銷。
Corely ERP 管正式庫存帳；WMS 保存實物交運證據，不直接扣 ERP 帳面庫存。待核銷期間保留原銷單預留；逐行核准才扣正式庫存，同一行重試不可重複扣庫，部分出貨只過帳已核准量。
此頁讀取需要庫存讀取權限，核准另需庫存更新權限；409 衝突代表須重新核對，不可視作過帳成功。ERP／WMS 的 60＋40 件配對只完成隔離 DEV 合成試驗，不代表實體交運或正式環境驗收。

en.title: WMS handover reconciliation and final stock posting
en.summary: Compare actual WMS handover, package and logistics evidence with ERP sales orders, then manually approve final stock deduction line by line.

steps: Select a company and filter pending, posted or all events; search by Taiwan handover date, order number, event ID or SKU.
Open an event and compare each line's ordered, previously posted and actually handed-over quantities. Check package totals, handover method, carrier and tracking or manifest reference.
Staff with inventory update access confirm evidence and quantities, then approve each line for posting. Refresh and investigate if the source, reservation or stock changed.
boundaries: Packing is not actual handover or final stock deduction. Only a real WMS handover event with package and logistics evidence enters reconciliation.

Corely ERP owns the posted inventory ledger; WMS stores physical handover evidence and does not directly deduct ERP on-hand stock. The sales-order reservation remains while pending. Each approved line posts final inventory once; retries must not deduct again, and partial shipments post only approved quantities.

Reading requires inventory read access; approval additionally needs inventory update access. A 409 conflict requires a new review and is not a successful posting. The paired ERP/WMS 60-plus-40 trial used synthetic isolated DEV data; it does not prove physical handover or production acceptance.

entries.title: 收發室工作台
entries.summary: 售後待到貨案件自動列入清單，收到實物後逐件登記、核對、檢查與交接。

steps: 待到貨清單自動顯示售後維修與退貨案件及尚未到貨數量；選定案件後，只登記這次實際收到的物件。
維修品保留原申報並核對實收 SKU／SN；一致時指派維修人員，不一致交承辦客服確認。
維修人員可在收發室平板輸入本人員編、密碼及已設定的驗證碼，再勾選實物確認簽收；收發室帳號持續登入。
退貨品必須記錄品項核對、包裝、外觀、配件、AA／A／B／C 與至少一張照片；承辦客服另有接手檢查結果的待辦。
交接前原保管人仍負責物件，本人簽收後才變更保管人。信件、包裹與待辨識件也逐件保留位置及歷程。
boundaries: 工作台需先啟用，操作仍依公司、權限、逐件指派及目前進度限制；售後建案不代表實物已到貨。
AA 須為全新未使用且配件完整，預定重新入庫；A 瑕疵補寄或福利品；B／C 整理後福利品。本階段只記錄去向，不會自動加庫存、扣退款或發送 LINE 訊息。
品項不符與退貨檢查只交承辦客服；承辦客服須以員工信箱對應同公司、在職且有覆核權限的帳號。未完成映射會提示，不廣播給全部客服。
客服接手檢查結果不等於完成整新或核准退款。「待同步」也不代表售後或 AI 已收到。
收發室基本讀取權限不自動包含檢修與維修文件；完整技術文件及版本需 repair_workbench:read 或 mailroom:review，填寫仍限本人已簽收且保管物件的維修師。

en.title: Mailroom workbench
en.summary: After-sales cases appear in the awaiting-arrival queue; register, verify, inspect and hand over each physical item after arrival.

steps: The awaiting-arrival queue shows repair and return cases and remaining quantities. Select a case and register only the physical pieces received this time.
Preserve the original repair claim and compare actual SKU and serial number. Assign matching items to repair; send mismatches to the responsible customer-service staff member.
On the mailroom tablet, the assigned technician enters their employee number, password and configured verification code, then confirms physical receipt. The clerk stays signed in.
Returns require an item match, packaging, appearance, accessories, AA/A/B/C grade and at least one photo. Responsible customer service receives a separate inspection acknowledgment task.
Custody stays with the sender until personal acceptance. Letters, parcels and unidentified items also retain individual locations and history.
boundaries: The workbench must be enabled. Company, permissions, assignment and current state remain authoritative; creating a case does not mean physical arrival.

AA requires an unused product with complete accessories and is intended for restock; A goes to replacement or welfare sale; B/C is refurbished for welfare sale. This phase records disposition without posting stock, deducting refunds or sending LINE messages.

Mismatches and return inspection go only to the responsible customer-service staff member. Their email must map to an active employee in the same company with review permission. Missing mappings are flagged without broadcasting to all reviewers.
Acknowledging inspection does not complete refurbishment or approve a refund. Pending sync does not mean after-sales or AI received the event.

Basic mailroom read access does not include inspection and repair records. Full technical records and versions require repair_workbench:read or mailroom:review; only the personally accepting technician with current custody can write them.

entries.title: DOA 售後維修工作台
entries.summary: 維修師查看客服已建案、在途、待簽收及本人處理案件，填寫檢修單與維修單。顧客維修依客服確認及必要款項放行；公司退貨整新依本人工作單、複驗與實物交接。

steps: 側邊欄以「DOA 售後維修」為分類，工作台正式名稱為「DOA 售後維修工作台」，使用案件總覽、待認領與簽收、我的檢修、客服與付款進度、複驗與交回、檢修與維修紀錄六個清單。案件總覽保留客服已建案、待到貨與在途資訊；建案或認領均不代表收到實物。
核對原申報及實收 SKU／SN、配件與位置；由本人認領或接受指派，再本人確認實物簽收。簽收後才開始實物檢測；交接前保管責任仍在原持有人。
維修師本人填寫檢修單：顧客故障描述、測試項目與條件、測試結果、能否重現、原因與依據、保固／收費建議、處理方案及估價。未重現或原因不明要據實保留；檢修單不能當作已完成維修。 檢修單及維修單各自保存草稿、正式送出與版本歷史。 列印內部檢修單時使用已保存版本，不包含未保存修改。
顧客維修案件（REPAIR）無論建議免費或付費，都須將已提交檢修單交客服，針對目前版次覆核並記錄結果；正式對客報價、顧客同意與必要款項入帳另以售後來源為準。開始維修或替換須同時有目前版次覆核及來源 repairAllowed。本地覆核不代表顧客已同意或已入帳。公司退貨庫存整新（RETURN／REFURBISHING）另依本人檢修、維修單及複驗交回，不套用顧客付款或客服維修放行門檻。
維修師本人填寫維修單，記錄實際維修或一對一替換、零件與工時、修後複驗結果；替換另留原機／替換機 SN、全新品或整新品品況、來源與原機去向。內部料源及成本與對客說明分開；對客內容應符合實際處置。
複驗結果須通過（PASS）後才可交回收發室，收發室本人簽收後才完成實物交接。案件進度、交辦待發送／已發送／已接收／已回覆及通知送達狀態分別核對；等待案件顯示卡住原因與下一位負責人。
boundaries: 「維修師」職務範本使用 REPAIR_TECHNICIAN，授予 repair_workbench:read 與 repair_workbench:update；它不授予客服審核、會計入帳確認、庫存核銷或跨公司權限。實際操作仍受啟用開關、公司、逐件指派、本人簽收及目前進度限制。

所有顧客維修方案（REPAIR）須客服覆核目前檢修版次及售後來源放行；付費案件另須完成正式報價、顧客同意與必要款項確認。檢修提交新版使舊覆核失效，須重交客服；本地覆核與匯款回報均不代表已入帳。本輪不新增會計入帳、AI 客服報價或虛擬帳號對帳連線。公司退貨整新（RETURN）不要求顧客同意、付款或維修版次客服覆核；仍須本人工作單及複驗合格才能交回。舊待客服案件缺檢修單可退回補填，但這不形成覆核或開工放行。
案件狀態、交辦狀態及通知狀態各自保存。待發送不等於已發送，已發送不等於對方接手，已讀通知不等於完成交辦；同步送達也不是顧客同意或會計入帳證明。
整新品必須有檢測、必要整新與複驗合格紀錄，AA／A／B／C 外觀分級不能直接作為替換資格。案件只記錄替換品與庫存需求時，不代表 WMS 已預留、出庫或正式核銷；不得把待串接紀錄當成庫存異動。
本人填寫的檢修單與維修單分別保留診斷和實際處理證據；維修單綁定檢修單版次，檢修改版後須重新提交維修單。送原廠或原件退回方案不能直接當作已修理或已替換完成。靜態指南不建立新的 AI 執行工具，不代替現場檢驗、安全基準或技術主管訂定的各機種合格值。

en.title: DOA after-sales repair workbench
en.summary: Technicians see created, in-transit, pending-receipt and assigned cases and complete inspection and repair records. Customer repairs require review and any needed payment release; company return refurbishment follows technician records, verification and physical handoff.

steps: The sidebar group is DOA after-sales repair, and the formal page name is DOA after-sales repair workbench. Use its six queues: case overview, claim and acceptance, my inspections, customer-service and payment progress, verification and return, and inspection and repair records. Overview retains created, awaiting-arrival and in-transit cases; creating or claiming a case does not mean physical receipt.

Compare claimed and actual SKU, serial number, accessories and location. Claim or accept an assignment, then personally confirm the physical item before inspection. Custody stays with the current holder until the next recipient accepts it.

The technician personally completes the inspection sheet: customer symptom, test items and conditions, results, reproducibility, cause and supporting evidence, warranty/fee suggestion, proposed action and estimate. Preserve not-reproduced or undetermined findings. An inspection sheet is not a completed repair record. Inspection and repair records each retain drafts, submitted versions and version history. Printing the internal inspection sheet uses its saved version and excludes unsaved edits.

For customer repair cases (REPAIR), both free and paid proposals require customer-service review against the current submitted inspection revision. Formal customer quoting, consent and any needed accounting receipt remain separate in the after-sales source. Starting repair or replacement requires both current-revision review and source repairAllowed. Local review is neither customer consent nor confirmed funds. Company return refurbishment (RETURN/REFURBISHING) separately follows technician documents, verification and physical return; customer payment and repair-review release gates do not apply.

The technician personally completes the repair record: actual repair or one-for-one replacement, parts, labor and post-work verification. Replacement additionally keeps old and replacement serial numbers, new or refurbished condition, source and original-item disposition. Separate internal stock source and costs from customer-facing content, which must reflect actual treatment.

Verification must pass (PASS) before the item can be returned to the mailroom for personal acceptance. Track case progress, pending/sent/received/replied handoffs and notification delivery separately. Waiting items identify the blocker and next responsible person.
boundaries: The Repair technician job template uses REPAIR_TECHNICIAN with repair_workbench:read and repair_workbench:update. It grants no customer-service review, accounting payment confirmation, inventory posting or cross-company access. Feature enablement, company, item assignment, personal acceptance and current state remain authoritative.

Every customer repair proposal (REPAIR) requires current-revision customer-service review and after-sales release; paid work additionally needs formal quoting, customer consent and confirmed required funds. New inspection submission invalidates old review and must return to customer service. Local review and reported remittance are not confirmed payment. This phase adds no accounting receipt, AI customer-service quoting or virtual-account reconciliation connection. Company return refurbishment (RETURN) requires no customer consent, payment or repair-revision customer-service review, but still needs technician documents and successful verification before return. A legacy waiting case without inspection may return for backfill without creating review or repair release.

Case, handoff and notification states are separate. Pending is not sent, sent is not accepted, and reading a notification does not complete a task. Sync delivery is neither customer consent nor evidence of received funds.

Refurbished replacements require inspection, any needed refurbishment and successful verification. AA/A/B/C cosmetic grading does not establish replacement eligibility. Recording replacement identity or stock needs does not reserve, ship or post WMS stock; pending integration records are not inventory movements.

Inspection and repair records retain the technician’s diagnosis and actual work evidence separately. A repair record binds to the inspection revision and must be resubmitted after inspection changes. Factory service and original-item return plans cannot directly be marked repaired or replaced. This static guide adds no AI execution tools and cannot replace physical inspection, safety criteria or model-specific acceptance limits established by the technical lead.

entries.title: 我的待辦與收件
entries.summary: 由右上角「我的待辦」或站內通知進入指定物件。

steps: 由右上角「我的待辦」或站內通知進入指定物件。
確認名稱、位置與實物後，由收件本人勾選確認並簽領。
通知已讀僅代表看過；待辦於完成簽領或處理後結束。
承辦客服從本人指定的顧客維修待辦（REPAIR）唯讀查看檢修單與維修單，針對目前檢修版次覆核並記錄結果；不能代維修師填寫技術紀錄。本地覆核不等於正式對客報價、顧客同意或會計入帳，這些另以售後來源為準。
boundaries: 工作台需先啟用，實際操作仍依公司、權限、逐件指派及目前進度限制。
AA 重新入庫；A 瑕疵補寄或福利品；B／C 整理後福利品。本階段只記錄去向，不會自動加庫存、扣退款或發送 LINE 訊息。
客服同步的「待同步」不能解讀為對方已收到。品項不符須由有覆核權限的客服記錄顧客確認結果。
檢修與維修文件及完整版本歷史另需 repair_workbench:read 或 mailroom:review；能進入我的待辦不會自動取得這些文件或他人的實物操作權。

en.title: My tasks and receipts
en.summary: Open the addressed item from My inbox or an in-app notification.

steps: Open the addressed item from My inbox or an in-app notification.
Verify the item and location, then personally confirm physical receipt.
Reading a notification does not complete the task; the actual handoff or processing does.

Responsible customer service reads inspection and repair records from their assigned customer repair task (REPAIR) and records review against the current inspection revision. They cannot write technical records on the technician’s behalf. Local review is not formal customer quoting, consent or accounting receipt; these remain authoritative in the after-sales source.
boundaries: The workbench must be enabled. Company, permissions, item assignment and current state remain authoritative.

AA returns to stock; A goes to replacement or welfare sale; B/C is refurbished for welfare sale. This phase records the intended disposition without posting stock, deducting refunds or sending LINE messages.
Pending sync does not mean the destination received the event. A permitted customer-service reviewer must record customer confirmation for a mismatch.

Inspection and repair documents and full version history additionally require repair_workbench:read or mailroom:review. Opening My inbox does not grant these records or authority over another person’s physical items.
